This phone does not report a step counter sensor, so the app cannot count steps. Please copy the diagnostics below and send them over.
Android only lets an app read the step sensor after you allow \"Physical activity\". Notifications are needed for the step count on the lock screen.
Phones stop background apps to save battery. Allowing background activity keeps the count running and lets the app restart counting by itself if the system stops it.
